The '''''Relentless''''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] ship used as a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] by [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="SWL30" />

==Characteristics==
The vessel was shaped similarly to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Fury-class starfighter|''Fury''-class starfighter]], with two wings extending from the central hull.<ref name="SWL30" /> The vessel had an [[Observation deck/Legends|observation deck]]<ref name="SWL30" /> and a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] big enough for at least one [[Nune-class Imperial shuttle|''Nune''-class shuttle]].<ref name="SWL31" />

==History==
The vessel was used to transport [[Darth Krayt]] and an entourage of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] - Lords [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Wyyrlok]], [[Darth Maladi|Maladi]], [[Darth Stryfe|Stryfe]] and [[Darth Talon|Talon]] - to [[Had Abbadon]] for a [[Mission to Had Abbadon|meeting]] with the deceased Sith Lord [[Karness Muur]].<ref name="SWL30" /> It stayed in orbit of Had Abbadon while the events unfolded below. By this time, the ''Relentless'' commanding officer was [[Rokure]], an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]].<ref name="SWL31" />
